newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai seizes hairy clams to curb hepatitis.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai seizes hairy clams to curb hepatitis.

text.p: Shanghai city officials have seized large quantities of hairy clams blamed for a rise in the hepatitis rate in China's largest city, the Business News reported on Sunday.

The newspaper said 10 tonnes of the clams had been offered for illegal sale since the beginning of January alone, 21 percent of which were found to be infected with hepatitis. It gave no further details.

The newspaper said the hepatitis rate in Shanghai in September, October and November last year was around 10 percent to 20 percent higher than the same period in 1995, without giving specific figures.
It called on residents to forego the gourmet experience to prevent the further spread of the disease.
